name: Overseer
persona: The headman of the village: speaks for the Furnace, and always has work for strong hands.

greet: In the name of the Furnace — a new face!
quest: We need {need}. Bring it and {village} owes you.
Find {need} out there on the map and come back to me.
thanks: You are a friend of {village} now. {reward}

say: {village} is a village of the Dark Dwarves. Soot-black smiths of fire and iron; they trade fairly, build cruelly, and think every other folk a fuel.
